pages.name: P&L
pages.title: Synthetic operating P&L — reporting currency USD
pages.usageTips: Prerequisites: open this generated PBIP in Power BI Desktop, refresh the inline sample model, then save as PBIX. Field roles: Lines = StatementLines[SectionID] > [LineID], Period = Period[Period], values = Actual/Budget/Prior measures. Formatting, signs and variance behavior come from the line metadata setting. Use +/- only for delivered children; Shift+F10 or right-click opens the Power BI context menu and host-defined drillthrough when a destination page is configured.

pages.name: Balance sheet
pages.title: Synthetic balance sheet — period-end snapshots
pages.usageTips: Tips: Balance lines are disconnected presentation rows; all totals and period-end balances are supplied by model measures, not calculated by the visual. Bind Lines to BalanceLines[LineID], Period to Period[Period], and Actual/Budget/Prior to BS measures. Line metadata controls display formats and favorability. Context menu, tooltips and drillthrough are native Power BI behaviors and require eligible selected fields plus a configured destination.

pages.name: Cash flow
pages.title: Synthetic cash bridge — contiguous periods only
pages.usageTips: Tips: Cash flow uses a disconnected one-level Lines role and model-supplied CF Actual/Budget/Prior measures. Select contiguous periods for bridge checks; the sample does not invent missing-period movement. Formatting and variance rules come from cash-flow line metadata. Use Shift+F10/right-click for Power BI context menu and configured drillthrough; refresh the inline sample model before saving the final PBIX.
